title: Customers charged twice for the same order
description: Several customers wrote in saying they see two charges on their card statement for one order. It started after yesterday's checkout release. We have refunded 6 of them by hand so far and more are coming in.
business_impact: Manual refund work for support and a growing risk of card disputes.
evidence: Orders 88214 and 88231 each show two successful charges at the payment provider.
Both charges for each order are about 1 second apart.
Support has refunded 6 customers manually.

title: Primary database out of disk, writes failing
description: Alerts fired at 02:14. The disk on db-primary is at 100% and every write fails with 'no space left on device'. Reads from the replicas still work. Nobody can place an order and it has been like this for about 40 minutes.
business_impact: No new orders or account changes can be saved.
evidence: Disk usage graph flat at 100% since 02:11.
Application logs show 'no space left on device' on every INSERT.
Replica lag is growing.

title: Admin export link works in a private window
description: A customer pasted the URL of the admin CSV export into a private browser window and the file downloaded without asking them to log in. The link had been posted in a public Slack channel last week. The file lists names and emails for about 4,000 users.
business_impact: Personal data of thousands of users may have been downloaded by people who should not have it.
evidence: Reproduced in a private window and with curl, no cookie needed.
The export URL has no expiry in it.

title: Password reset emails never arrive for Outlook accounts
description: Users with @outlook.com and @hotmail.com addresses say the reset email never shows up, not even in spam, after 30 minutes. Gmail accounts get it within a minute. 14 tickets about this since Monday.
business_impact: These users cannot get back into their accounts and have to ask support for help.
evidence: 14 tickets since Monday, all Outlook or Hotmail.
The email service shows these messages as 'delivered' on our side.

title: Something looks off in the workspace
description: Hi, something looks off in our workspace since this morning. I tried refreshing and logging out and back in, but it still doesn't look right. I can't tell what's changed or which part is causing it. Could someone check?
note: The report does not identify a specific feature, observable failure, or business impact. There is not enough evidence to assign a severity or category; tech_support is appropriate for initial investigation.

title: Customer record save hangs for some agents
description: This started after yesterday's update. A few of us are getting stuck when we change a customer's phone number and hit Save. For one attempt the request never showed up in the browser network tab; another time we got a 500 back from the API. Refreshing fixes it for some people, but not everyone. It is slowing down the team because we're having to retry updates.
note: Team ownership is unclear. The missing browser request suggests a frontend form/state problem, while the HTTP 500 suggests a backend failure. The evidence does not establish whether these are the same failure or which team owns the primary fix.
business_impact: Some support agents cannot reliably save customer record changes and have to retry or use another session.
evidence: The issue was first reported after the latest update.
One failed attempt showed no save request in the browser network tab.
A separate failed attempt returned HTTP 500 from the API.
Refreshing the page helps some agents but does not consistently resolve it.

title: Reports page takes over a minute for large accounts
description: The reports page now takes more than a minute to load for accounts with over 50,000 rows. It used to take around 10 seconds. Smaller accounts are fine. I am not sure if it changed with a release or if the data just grew.
business_impact: Our biggest customers cannot use reports in practice, and two have complained.
evidence: Account 4410 (62k rows): 74 seconds.
Account 1185 (3k rows): 2 seconds.

title: Date picker shows the wrong month on Safari
description: On Safari 17 on macOS, opening the date picker shows the month before the current one. Picking a date still works, you just have to click forward. Chrome and Firefox are fine.
business_impact: Small annoyance for Safari users.
evidence: Safari 17.2 on macOS 14.
Not reproducible on Chrome or Firefox.

title: Invoice total does not match the line items
description: Invoice INV-2291 has line items that add up to 1,240.00 but the total at the bottom says 1,264.00. The customer is in another country and has tax added. Finance found 3 more invoices like this since last month.
business_impact: Customers are billed amounts that do not match their invoice lines, and finance has to correct them.
evidence: INV-2291: lines sum to 1,240.00, total shows 1,264.00.
3 more invoices found by finance, all with tax added.

title: Why am I logged out on my phone?
description: I was logged out on my phone this morning but my laptop is still logged in. Has my account been hacked? I did not do anything. I just want to know if I should be worried.
business_impact: The user is worried about their account.
evidence: Mobile sessions are set to expire after 7 days in the current settings.
Last mobile login was 8 days ago.
note: The observed logout matches the configured 7-day mobile session expiry; the ticket provides no evidence of account compromise.

title: CSV import rejects files that worked last week
description: Importing a CSV that uses semicolons now fails with 'invalid delimiter'. The same file imported fine before the 5.2 update. Most of our European customers export with semicolons.
business_impact: Customers using semicolon files cannot import data and are blocked from onboarding.
evidence: Worked on 5.1, fails on 5.2.
Comma-separated files still import fine.

title: Pricing page and checkout disagree on the annual discount
description: The public pricing page says annual plans get 15% off, but at checkout the discount applied is 20%. Marketing says 20% is correct. Nobody is sure which one the page should show, and a few customers have already screenshotted the 15%.
business_impact: Confusing for customers and possibly a promise we did not intend to make.
evidence: Pricing page shows 15%.
Checkout applies 20%.
note: The evidence says the checkout discount is correct, so this is a pricing-content/requirements mismatch not clearly represented by the current category taxonomy.

title: Staging deploys stuck for three hours
description: The deploy-staging job has been pending since 11:00 with 'no runners available'. QA cannot test the release candidate. Production is not affected.
business_impact: The release is blocked until QA can test.
evidence: Job pending since 11:00.
All three CI runners show as offline.

title: No limit on login attempts
description: During an internal review we found that the login endpoint accepts about 500 attempts a minute from one address with no lockout and no delay. We have not seen any sign that anyone has used this.
business_impact: Accounts with weak passwords could be guessed by a script.
evidence: 500 attempts a minute from one address were all processed.
No abuse found in the logs for the last 30 days.

title: When does our contract renew?
description: Hi, can someone tell me when our contract renews and who I should talk to about changing our plan? I could not find it in the settings.
note: This is a general account/contract inquiry, which has no dedicated category in the current taxonomy; the ticket does not establish business impact.

title: CSV export breaks when customer notes contain line breaks
description: Since the 5.3 release, exporting a customer list produces a malformed CSV if any notes contain a line break. The export says it completed, but rows after the affected note shift into the wrong columns. Exports for records with ordinary notes still look fine. We noticed it while preparing this month's reconciliation file.
business_impact: Staff cannot reliably use the exported file for reconciliation and have started correcting affected rows by hand.
evidence: The same records exported correctly on version 5.2.
The issue reproduces when a note contains an embedded line break.
Exports without line breaks appear normal.

title: Orders remain unpaid after the card payment is captured
description: We've had 23 orders today where checkout went through on the customer's bank app, but our order page still says 'Payment pending'. Support checked several cases in the payment dashboard and the funds were captured. Customers are contacting us because they have receipts but no confirmed order.
business_impact: Order and payment records disagree, causing fulfilment delays and manual reconciliation for support and finance.
evidence: The payment provider shows successful captures for sampled affected orders.
The corresponding orders remain in the pending payment state.
23 affected orders have been reported since this morning.

title: Save button is hidden behind the keyboard on iPhone
description: When I edit my delivery address on my iPhone, the on-screen keyboard covers the Save button. I can finish the form if I dismiss the keyboard first, but it isn't obvious and I thought the page had frozen. I haven't seen it on my laptop.
business_impact: A minor mobile usability problem makes address edits harder, but a simple workaround is available.
evidence: Reproduced on an iPhone using Safari.
The Save button becomes visible after dismissing the keyboard.
The same form works normally in a desktop browser.

title: Changing the invoice ID in the URL shows another company's invoice
description: While checking an invoice, I changed the number at the end of the URL and it opened an invoice belonging to a different company. I was logged in as a normal customer user, not an admin. I stopped testing after confirming that the company name and invoice amount were different.
business_impact: A customer may be able to view another customer's confidential billing information without authorization.
evidence: A normal customer account could retrieve an invoice from another company by changing the invoice ID.
The returned page showed a different company name and invoice amount.
The ticket does not establish how many records may be affected or whether anyone else accessed them.

title: Notifications and exports stuck in the queue after Redis failover
description: Since the Redis failover around 9:20, email notifications and report exports have been sitting in the queue. The site is still up and orders are going through. I restarted one worker and it cleared a few jobs, then got stuck again. I'm seeing Redis reconnect warnings, but there are also a few 'cannot decode job payload' errors in the worker log. Not sure if Redis is still flapping or the worker is choking on some jobs.
business_impact: Order placement still works, but notification emails and report exports are delayed and the queue continues to grow.
evidence: The queue stopped draining around the Redis failover at approximately 09:20.
Restarting one worker briefly cleared some jobs, but processing stalled again.
Worker logs contain Redis reconnect warnings and errors decoding some job payloads.
The available logs do not establish whether queue connectivity or worker job handling is the primary cause.
note: Team ownership is genuinely unclear. Repeated Redis reconnects point to devops/runtime reliability, while job-payload decoding errors point to backend worker processing. The ticket does not show which is causing the queue to stop.

title: Search results take 10 seconds for larger customer accounts
description: Search used to return in about a second, but this week it takes 9–12 seconds for our larger accounts. Small accounts still feel normal. Agents have started opening records in separate tabs because waiting for each search is slowing down calls.
business_impact: Support agents handling larger accounts spend significantly more time finding customer records, though search still completes.
evidence: A test account with about 28,000 records takes 10.6 seconds to return results.
A test account with about 1,200 records takes 1.1 seconds.
No specific code or infrastructure change has yet been confirmed as the cause.
note: The root cause is not confirmed, but the ticket clearly identifies a backend search-performance problem.

title: SSO keeps sending staff back to the login page
description: Staff started getting bounced back to the login page around lunch, just after the SSO certificate was changed. The identity provider says the sign-ins are successful. The app has 'signature validation failed' in the logs, but one pod seems to accept the same users while another keeps redirecting them. There was an app release this morning too, including a SAML library update, so we're not sure which change is behind it. About 35 people are affected and they can't use password login as a fallback.
business_impact: Around 35 staff members cannot access the internal console because local-password login is disabled for their accounts.
evidence: The issue began around the SSO certificate rotation; an application release with a SAML library update also occurred that morning.
The identity provider reports successful sign-ins, while some application logs show signature-validation failures.
The same users appear to succeed on one application pod and fail on another.
Affected accounts have no local-password fallback.
note: Team ownership is unclear. The certificate rotation and pod-specific behavior suggest an SSO certificate/trust configuration issue for devops, but the simultaneous SAML library update and inconsistent validation could indicate a backend integration defect.

title: Can we require approval for discounts above 10 percent?
description: Our sales managers review large discounts in email today, and it's easy to lose track of who approved what. Could the system ask for a manager's approval whenever a salesperson enters a discount above 10%, then keep the approval with the quote? This isn't supported in the current form.
business_impact: The current manual process takes time and makes discount approvals harder to track, but sales can continue using email.
evidence: The current quote form accepts discounts without an approval workflow.
The requester asks for new approval functionality rather than reporting a failed existing requirement.

title: Cancelled annual subscriptions were charged at renewal
description: A few customers who cancelled their annual plans last month were charged again on the renewal date. We found 11 affected accounts so far and have refunded 4 after customers contacted us. The cancellation confirmation is visible in their account history.
business_impact: Customers are being charged after cancellation, creating refund work and a risk of disputes if the issue continues.
evidence: Cancellation confirmations predate the renewal charges for the affected accounts.
The billing provider shows successful renewal charges on 11 accounts.
Four refunds have been processed manually.

title: Profile form keeps Save disabled after a valid postal code is entered
description: On the profile page, Save stays greyed out after I replace an invalid postal code with a valid one. If I reload the page and enter the address again, it sometimes works. The same account can save the form from another browser.
business_impact: Some users cannot reliably update their profile without retrying or switching browsers.
evidence: The form remains disabled after the postal-code validation message disappears.
Reloading the page can temporarily restore the form.
No corresponding API error was observed during the failed attempt.

title: A used password-reset link can change the password again
description: During a support-assisted test, we used a password-reset link to change the password, then opened the same link again in another browser. It still showed the reset form and accepted a second password change. We have not found evidence of anyone abusing this, but the link should probably stop working after use.
business_impact: Anyone who obtains a previously used reset link may be able to reset the account password again while the token remains valid.
evidence: The same reset token was accepted for two separate password changes.
The token remains valid after the first successful reset.
No confirmed abuse was found during the initial review.
note: The security-control weakness is confirmed; the absence of known abuse does not remove the exposure.

title: EU invoice exports failing since this morning’s deploy
description: The scheduled invoice exports in EU started failing after this morning's deploy. The same jobs are still running in the other regions. I checked one of the pods and REPORT_BUCKET is empty, even though it's in the release values. The app config code was changed in this release as well. Finance is sending the files manually for now—can someone help figure out where the setting is getting lost?
business_impact: EU customers are not receiving scheduled invoice exports, so finance staff are sending some files manually.
evidence: Scheduled invoice exports began failing in the EU region after this morning’s deployment; other regions still work.
A running pod reports REPORT_BUCKET as empty, although the setting appears in the release values.
The same release also changed application configuration-loading code.
The available evidence does not show whether the variable is lost at deployment/runtime or mishandled by the application.
note: Team ownership is genuinely unclear. Devops may be failing to inject the configured variable into the EU runtime, while backend code may be reading the changed configuration incorrectly. The ticket does not establish where the value is lost.

title: All checkout API requests return 503 after a load-balancer change
description: Checkout stopped working for everyone at 14:07. Every attempt to place an order gets a 503 page. The application team says the pods are healthy and there have been no application errors because requests are not reaching them. The only change just before the outage was a load-balancer rule update.
business_impact: Customers cannot place orders, and no effective workaround is available while checkout is unavailable.
evidence: Production checkout requests have returned 503 since 14:07.
Application pods pass their health checks and show no corresponding incoming requests.
The load-balancer rule was updated immediately before the outage.

title: Refunds revert to pending when an older provider webhook arrives
description: Finance noticed seven refunds that the payment provider marks as completed are showing as pending in our admin screen. Looking at the event history for one refund, the completed event arrived first and an older pending event arrived a few seconds later. The admin screen changed back to pending after the older event.
business_impact: Refund status is inaccurate, making reconciliation harder and causing support to give customers incorrect updates about their refunds.
evidence: The payment provider shows the sampled refunds as completed.
A later-arriving webhook contains an older pending status and overwrites the completed state.
Seven refunds have been identified so far.

title: Audit export is taking ages and the CSV is missing rows
description: Finance is trying to finish the audit export and it's been odd since Friday's release. For the same month and filters it used to finish in 3–5 seconds; now it sits there for about 40 seconds. Twice we've also got a CSV with a chunk of rows missing from the end. I can't tell if the export is timing out while it runs or if the release has broken the output. We need a complete file for next week's audit.
business_impact: Audit preparation is delayed, and files with missing rows cannot be used without checking them manually.
evidence: The same date range previously exported in 3–5 seconds and now takes about 40 seconds.
Two recent CSV files were missing rows at the end.
Both symptoms were noticed after Friday’s release, but no evidence shows whether they share a cause or which is the primary issue.
note: Category is genuinely ambiguous between performance and regression. The export is significantly slower, but rows are also missing after a recent release. The ticket does not establish whether the primary issue is latency or a change that breaks previously working output.
